messages.content:
Ти — HR-асистент. Відповідаєш рекрутеру чи HR-фахівцю лише на основі наданих джерел: законодавство України, роз'яснення органів влади та внутрішні документи вигаданої компанії Polaris Demo LLC.

Як відповідати:
1. Перше речення — пряма відповідь на питання (число, строк, так/ні, хто погоджує). Далі — умови й винятки, якщо вони важливі. До 5 речень.
2. Кожне речення з фактом закінчуй посиланням на джерело у квадратних дужках: [2] або [1][3]. Посилайся на те джерело, де цей факт справді написаний.
3. Використовуй тільки інформацію з джерел. Не додавай знань ззовні, навіть якщо впевнений.
4. Якщо в питанні є число чи поріг, застосуй правило з джерела саме до нього і перевір: наприклад, 8 000 грн — це «понад 5 000 грн».
5. Зверни увагу, про кого питання: працівник чи роботодавець, компанія чи закон, конкретний відділ чи всі. Не підміняй норму для однієї сторони нормою для іншої. Якщо закон і політика компанії дають різні правила, назви обидва й скажи, чиє яке.
6. Нижче питання може бути список «Припущення користувача». Перевір кожне за джерелами. Якщо джерело каже інакше (інше число, інший строк, виплати чи дозволу немає), почни відповідь з виправлення: «Ні, ...» або «У документах інакше: ...», наведи чинне правило з посиланням і лише потім відповідай на решту питання. Хибне припущення — не привід писати «Не знаю». Якщо припущення підтверджується — просто відповідай.
7. Джерело з позначкою «НЕЧИННА, застаріла версія» використовуй, лише коли питають саме про стару версію; тоді скажи, що вона застаріла, і, якщо є, наведи чинне правило.
8. Якщо спеціальний закон змінює загальне правило (наприклад, Закон № 2136-IX про трудові відносини в умовах воєнного стану змінює норму КЗпП), назви обидва: загальне правило і те, що діє в період воєнного стану.
9. Якщо жодне джерело не описує ситуацію з питання, відповідь має починатися рівно з фрази «Не знаю: у документах немає відповіді на це питання.» (англійською — «I don't know: the documents do not answer this question.»), без «Ні», «Джерела не містять» чи інших варіантів: за цією фразою система розпізнає відмову. Далі одним реченням скажи, що в документах є близького. Якщо ти можеш навести хоча б одне правило з джерел, яке прямо стосується питання, відповідай ним і фразу «Не знаю» не пиши.

Відповідай мовою питання.

Джерела:

[1] Labour Code of Ukraine (official English translation) — Section I GENERAL PROVISIONS > Article 9-1. Additional, in comparison with the legislation, labour and social benefits (версія current, чинна)
Enterprises, institutions, organisations within the limits of their powers and at their own expense can establish additional, in comparison with the legislation, labour and social benefits for employees.

The enterprise may financially reward employees of medical, children's, cultural and educational, educational and sports institutions, catering organisations and organisations that serve the labour collective and are not part of it.

[2] Labour Code of Ukraine (official English translation) — Section XVI TRADE UNIONS. EMPLOYEES' PARTICIPATION IN THE MANAGEMENT OF ENTERPRISES, INSTITUTIONS, ORGANISATIONS > Article 245. The Right of Employees to Participate in the Management of Enterprises, Institutions, Organisations (версія current, чинна)
Employees shall have the right to participate in the management of enterprises, institutions, organisations through general meetings (conferences), personnel councils, trade unions operating in work communities, other bodies authorised by the personnel of the enterprise, to represent, make proposals to improve the work of enterprises, institutions, organisations, as well as on social, cultural and consumer services.

The owner or his/her authorised body shall create conditions that would ensure the participation of employees in the management of enterprises, institutions and organisations. Officials of enterprises, institutions, organisations shall consider critical remarks and suggestions of employees in due time and inform them about the taken measures.

[3] Employee Handbook V2 — 1. About this handbook (версія 2025-03-01, чинна)
Effective 2025-03-01. Replaces Employee Handbook V1 of 2024-01-15.

Fictional company. Course project document, not legal advice.

## 1. About this handbook

This handbook explains the main rules of working at Polaris Demo LLC: working time, leave, remote work, equipment and conduct. Where the handbook and the Labour Code of Ukraine differ, the Labour Code applies. Questions go to the HR team at hr@polaris-demo.example.

[4] Labour Code of Ukraine (official English translation) — Chapter IV WORKING HOURS > Article 60. Flexible working hours (версія current, чинна)
In the case of assigning an employee for a business trip, they are subject to the work mode established at the enterprise (institution, organisation) whereto they were assigned.

Flexible working hours can be set as follows:

1) at the request of an employee with acceptable time limits for the work schedule without complying with the requirements for notifying the employee of a change in work mode no later than two months;

2) by the owner or their authorised body in case of production necessity with obligatory notification of the employee about a change of the work mode not later than two months.

The owner of the enterprise, institution, organisation or their authorised body shall make employees aware of the conditions and specifics of flexible working hours at least two months before the introduction of such a mode and ensure work hours recording and effective control over the fullest and most rational use of working time.

The owner of the enterprise, institution, organisation or their authorised body approves the working hours of the employee for whom flexible working hours are established by regulating the fixed time, shift time, and break time for rest and meals of other employees, based on the working hours structure and the established recording period of its duration for each employee.

The introduction of flexible working hours does not entail changes in standardisation, remuneration and does not affect the scope of labour rights of employees.

In case of violating the established flexible working hours, the employee may be transferred to the general work mode without complying with the requirement to notify the employee, in addition to the application of appropriate disciplinary sanctions no later than two months of significant changes in working conditions.

The requirement for the owner or his authorised body to notify the employee of a change in the work mode established by this Article does not apply to the cases provided for in Part 2 of this Article.

[5] Law of Ukraine on Employment of the Population (unofficial ILO translation) — Article 45. Termination of registration of the unemployed (версія draft, чинна)
1. The registration of an unemployed person in the territorial body of the central executive body that implements the state policy in the sphere of population employment and labor migration shall be terminated in the event of:

- 1) employment of a person;

- 2) resumption of work based on a court decision that has entered into force;

3) submitting a written application to the unemployed in person to remove him from registration as unemployed or to refuse his services;

4) a two-time refusal to offer a suitable job, and for an unemployed person who is looking for work for the first time and does not have a profession (specialty), a two-time refusal to offer vocational training;

5) two-time refusal to offer a suitable job in a profession (specialty) acquired at the direction of the territorial body of the central executive body that implements state policy in the field of population employment and labor migration;

6) termination of vocational training by referral of the territorial body of the central executive body implementing state policy in the field of population employment and labor migration, without valid reasons;

7) failure to visit a territorial body of a central executive body that implements state policy in the field of population employment and labor migration without valid reasons within 30 working days from the day following the day on which it made a decision on such a visit;

__

1 7 ) non-confirmation without valid reasons by any means of communication, including electronic ones, of the intention to stay in the status of registered unemployed within 30 working days from the day following the day of the last confirmation (visit) (during a state of emergency or martial law, quarantine , in the event of an emergency);

8) establishment of the fact that the person submitted unreliable data and documents, on the basis of which a decision was made to grant him the status of registered unemployed, the appointment (payment) of financial support in the event of unemployment and the provision of social services;

[6] Employee Handbook V2 — 5. Remote work (версія 2025-03-01, чинна)
After probation, employees may work remotely up to three days per week. Remote days are agreed with the team lead in the HR portal at least one working day in advance. Warehouse and office-administration roles work on site.

For a home workplace, the company pays an allowance of 1,500 UAH per year for a chair, monitor or headset, against receipts.

[7] Employee Handbook V2 — 9. Performance reviews (версія 2025-03-01, чинна)
Each employee has a review with the team lead twice a year, in June and December. The review covers the goals of the half-year, feedback from colleagues and a development plan. Salary changes are discussed only at the December review.

[8] Кодекс законів про працю України — Глава I ЗАГАЛЬНІ ПОЛОЖЕННЯ > Стаття 2. Основні трудові права працівників (версія current, чинна)
інші права, встановлені законодавством.

Питання: Does the company offer stock options to employees?
